items.name: Baba Beach Club Natai
items.priceText: No rooms on sale for 8-27 Jan 2027: the official booking site and Google show no rates (checked 15 Oct 2026). On 1-6 Jan the official site shows about 13,450-15,960 THB / night.
items.whyStay: The Circoloco venue itself: a music hotel on Natai Beach with a Funktion-One sound system. No rooms are on sale for 8 to 27 Jan 2027, so for this trip it is your party venue. Stay in Kamala and book a driver.
items.description: Beach club hotel on Natai Beach in Phang Nga, run by the Sri panwa team. It has an entertainment pool, two restaurants, a beach bar, suites, pool suites and pool villas. Music plays across the property, also in rooms, by design. Circoloco Thailand is here on Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan 2027 (and 23 Jan).
items.nearby: Aleenta 8 min on foot (590 m). Airport about 35 min by car (25 km). Catch Beach Club (Bang Tao) about 50-60 min. Patong about 65-80 min.
tips: Circoloco runs here on Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan 2027 (also Sat 23 Jan), 3 PM to 3 AM.
No rooms can be booked online for your dates. To ask anyway, email phuket@bababeachclub.com or call +66 76 429 388.
Not for light sleepers: music plays across the hotel, also in the rooms.
Breakfast is included. The hotel airport transfer costs 1,800 THB per car each way (hotel FAQ).
Trip.com lists a deposit of 3,000 THB per night.
items.verification: Open: official site, FAQ and Circoloco page live; Google reviews 2-6 months old, no closure flag (15 Oct 2026). Circoloco 9/16/23 Jan, 3 PM-3 AM on the Baba page. Official booking engine shows 8-27 Jan 2027 blocked; Google shows rates for 4 and 28 Jan but none for 8-17 Jan. Funktion-One, 2 restaurants, breakfast and 1,800 THB transfer from hotel FAQ; in-room music from Phuket 101 (Sep 2026). Trip.com: 9.3/10, 49 reviews, 3,000 THB/night deposit. items.name: Aleenta Phuket Phang Nga Resort & Spa
items.priceText: Mon-Thu about 19,300 THB / night before tax (about 22,400 with tax, ~$665). Fri 8, Sun 10 and Fri 15 Jan about 30,000-33,000; Circoloco Saturdays (9 and 16 Jan) about 45,000-52,000 before tax.
items.whyStay: Quiet five-star resort next to Baba Beach Club. Walk to Circoloco in 8 minutes, then sleep in a calm suite. Most rooms have a private pool.
items.description: Quiet all-suite resort on Natai Beach with 87 suites and villas (official FAQ). Most have a private pool; the Ocean View Lofts share one. It has an infinity pool, a beach lounge, two restaurants (The Edge and SEASONS) and the AYURAH spa and wellness centre. Member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
items.nearby: Baba Beach Club 8 min on foot (590 m). Airport about 30-35 min by car (26 km). Few restaurants within walking distance.
tips: Prices jump 2-3 times on Circoloco Saturdays: Tue 12 Jan was about 19,400 THB, Sat 16 Jan about 52,000 THB (before tax).
Ocean View Lofts and Pool Suites take guests 12+ only. Pool villas and residences take all ages.
Food at the hotel is expensive and there is little nearby. Plan your meals.
Grab cars can be hard to find at the resort (hotel FAQ). Book your ride for Circoloco nights in advance or ask the concierge.

items.priceText: Weekdays about 1,700-2,400 THB / night before tax (about 2,000-2,800 with tax, ~$60-85). Fri 8, Sun 10, Fri 15 and Sun 17 Jan about 5,000-6,100. Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan: no rooms online (15 Oct 2026).
items.whyStay: Small owner-run resort 2 to 3 minutes from Natai Beach and 3 minutes by car from Baba Beach Club. Good value on Fridays and Sundays; Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan showed no rooms online (Oct 2026).
items.description: Small, calm resort near Natai Beach, run by its owner. Guests praise the big, clean rooms, the pool, the friendly staff and the breakfast. A small shop, cafe, restaurant and massage place are next door. One guest said the room was not cleaned after the first day.
items.nearby: Natai Beach 2-3 min on foot. Baba Beach Club 3 min by car or 22 min on foot (1.7 km). Airport about 35 min by car (28 km).

items.priceText: About 30,500-33,500 THB / night before tax (about 35,300-38,600 with tax, ~$1,050-1,150). Fri 8 and Sat 9 Jan showed no rooms online (15 Oct 2026).

items.whyStay: Cheap, social glamping in Rawai with tents, an 8-bed dorm and an infinity pool. 5 minutes by car to Nai Harn Beach. A fun budget base in the laid-back south.
items.description: Budget glamping site in Rawai. Choose a premium tent with AC and private bathroom, a fan tent, a 3-bed shared tent or an 8-bed dorm. There is an infinity pool, chilled-out music in an open-air space, and Tojo's Cafe & Bar (open 8:30-21:30).
items.nearby: Nai Harn Beach 5 min by car (2.6 km) or about 30 min on foot. Illuzion (Patong) about 30-40 min by car. Phuket Old Town about 30 min.
tips: Choose a tent with AC and a private bathroom for more comfort.
The beach is not close on foot. Rent a scooter or use Grab.

items.name: Casa Blanca Boutique Hotel
items.whyStay: Restored Sino-Portuguese shophouse hotel with a pool, in the heart of the Old Town. 4 minutes on foot to Thalang Road. Cheap, charming and close to cafes and street food.
items.description: Boutique hotel in restored Sino-Portuguese buildings at 26 Phuket Road in the Old Town. It has a garden, a coffee shop and a swimming pool. Rooms are Deluxe, Premium Deluxe and Family Suite. Good for culture, local food and the Sunday walking street.
items.nearby: Thalang Road 4 min on foot. Courage bar (underground nights, 16 Bangkok Road) about 20 min on foot (1.4 km). Patong about 30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.
tips: On Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan, visit the Lard Yai walking street on Thalang Road (about 16:00-22:00).
For underground parties in town (SUB, FAKE PALM), check ra.co. In Dec 2025-Feb 2026 they were at Courage bar on Bangkok Road.

items.name: The Memory at On On Hotel
items.whyStay: Sleep in Phuket Town's first hotel, a 1927 Sino-Portuguese building on Phang Nga Road. History and style, with the Old Town's cafes, food and bars at your door.
items.description: Phuket Town's first hotel, built in 1927 by craftsmen from Penang in Sino-Portuguese style, now restored as The Memory. It is a two-storey landmark on Phang Nga Road in the Old Town. You can walk everywhere in the old quarter.
items.nearby: Thalang Road about 6 min on foot. Courage bar (16 Bangkok Road) about 15 min on foot (1.2 km). Patong about 30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.
tips: On Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan, the Lard Yai walking street runs on Thalang Road (about 16:00-22:00).
Courage bar hosted SUB and FAKE PALM nights in Dec 2025-Feb 2026. Dates are irregular, so check ra.co and Instagram @courage.phuket.

items.name: Shunli Hotel
items.priceText: About 1,400 THB / night (~$41) on 12 and 14 Jan. Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan showed no online rate.
items.whyStay: Tiny owner-run hotel in the Old Town with a 5.0 Google score from 401 reviews. 10 bright rooms, breakfast included, a few minutes on foot to Thalang Road.
items.description: Small, simple hotel at 56 Krabi Road with 10 bright rooms, free Wi-Fi and a home-cooked breakfast. Guests love the kind owners and the central Old Town location. One guest mentions noise from delivery trucks at 3-5 am.
items.nearby: Thalang Road about 3-5 min on foot. Courage bar (16 Bangkok Road) about 18 min on foot (1.3 km). Patong about 30 min by car.
tips: Few online rates for January. Message the hotel on Facebook.
Light sleepers: ask for a room away from the street.

items.name: Milky Bay Resort
items.whyStay: Beachfront resort on Ban Tai beach with a pool. 5 minutes on foot to Chill Up, and 6-8 minutes by car to Halfmoon and OXA. A comfortable base for a Koh Phangan rave trip.
items.description: Mid-range resort on Ban Tai beach, Koh Phangan, with white Cape Dutch style buildings, garden courtyards, a beachfront pool and a beachfront restaurant. Rooms go from Urban Deluxe to an Oceanfront Pavilion. Ban Tai has several big jungle parties, like OXA and Halfmoon.
items.nearby: Chill Up 5 min on foot (400 m). Halfmoon Festival (Magical Forest) about 6 min by car. OXA about 8 min by car. Thong Sala Pier about 7 min by car.
tips: Koh Phangan is on the other coast of Thailand. From Phuket, take the Lomprayah bus + boat (about 7.5 hours) or fly to Koh Samui and take a ferry.
OXA runs most Fridays (21:00-05:00). Tickets for Fri 8, Fri 15 and Tue 19 Jan 2027 (moved for full-moon week) are on sale on Megatix (from 500 THB).
Taxis wait at the OXA exit until sunrise. Share one to pay less.
The price above was checked for 8-16 Jan. For full-moon week (19-23 Jan), check again early: rooms on the island cost more then and sell out.

items.name: Slumber Party Beach Koh Phangan
items.priceText: Dorm bed from about 580 THB / night (~$17, non-refundable) or about 800 THB (~$24) with a flexible rate (Hostelworld, Jan 2027).
items.whyStay: Beachfront party hostel in Ban Tai with a pool and a beach bar. Cheap beds, beer pong and an easy crowd for going out. 5 minutes by car from Thong Sala Pier.
items.description: Party hostel on Ban Tai beach with dorms, private rooms and tents. It has a pool and a beach bar. Guests praise the beach location and the staff. Recent reviews (Sept 2026) report water cuts, a dirty pool and unclean bathrooms.
items.nearby: On Ban Tai beach. Thong Sala Pier 5 min by car. Chill Up 19 min on foot. Halfmoon about 9 min and OXA about 10 min by car.
tips: Hostelworld says it normally accepts guests aged 18-35 only. Check before you book.
Good if you want a party crowd. Not for quiet nights.
Ask the staff about this week's jungle parties and shared taxis.
The price above was checked for 8-16 Jan. For full-moon week (19-23 Jan), check again early: rooms on the island cost more then and sell out.

items.name: The Luna Hostel Phuket Airport
items.priceText: 23-26 Jan 2027, 1 guest, taxes included: 6-bed dorm about 910-1,100 THB / night (~$27-33), 4-bed dorm about 1,160-1,400, female dorm about 1,240-1,500. Only 1 private room with own bathroom was left, about 2,650-3,200 (Hostelworld, 16 Oct 2026; the lower prices are a current 10% deal).
items.whyStay: The terminal is a 5-10 minute walk, or 2 minutes by car. Pool, free breakfast and a 24-hour reception, so you can come back late from Circoloco in Natai (35-45 min) or Café del Mar in Kamala (35-40 min).
items.description: Popular hostel a short walk from Phuket airport, with a tropical pool, free breakfast, a pool table and a social balcony. Mixed dorms, a female dorm and private rooms. The hostel says most guests are 18 to 35.
items.nearby: Airport terminal 0.7 km (5-10 min on foot, 2 min by car). Nai Yang Beach about 2 km. Baba Beach Club (Natai) about 26 km, 35-45 min. Café del Mar (Kamala) about 24 km, 35-40 min. Patong (Illuzion) about 37 km, 45-60 min.
tips: Check-out is at 12:00. Luggage storage and late check-out are listed; ask the price at reception.
From the airport, leave by Exit 1 or 2, turn right and walk past X-Terminal; the hostel is on your left (the hostel's own directions).
The non-refundable rate is about 8% cheaper. The flexible rate can be cancelled for free until 3-4 days before arrival.
Bring 200 baht in cash for the keycard deposit. You get it back at check-out.
Cheaper option nearby: Friends Hostel has 10-bed dorm beds for about 400-500 THB, but its reception closes at 21:00.

items.name: Atom Phuket Hotel
items.priceText: 23-26 Jan 2027, 1 guest, taxes included: 'Back Pack' twin room with shared bathroom about 770-1,000 THB / night (~$23-30). Rooms with own bathroom about 1,800-2,700 THB (Hostelworld and Google, 16 Oct 2026; the lower prices are a current Hostelworld deal).
items.whyStay: The cheapest private room in this list, 1.3 km from the terminal (about 5 minutes by car). A 24-hour front desk and a pool, good for late party nights and an easy last morning.
items.description: Small 3-star hotel in Sakhu, near Nai Yang, with an outdoor pool, a garden, a shared kitchen and a 24-hour front desk. The cheapest 'Back Pack' rooms share a bathroom; the others have their own. In Google reviews guests praise the clean rooms and the friendly reception.
items.nearby: Airport 1.3 km (about 5 min by car). Nai Yang Beach about 1 km (4 min by car). Baba Beach Club (Natai) about 35-45 min. Café del Mar (Kamala) about 30-40 min.
tips: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. The hotel keeps luggage.
Card payments at the hotel cost 3% extra (hotel note on Hostelworld), so bring cash.
Changes or cancellations must be made 7 days before arrival (hotel note on Hostelworld).

items.name: Proud Phuket Hotel
items.priceText: Official site, 1 guest, VAT and service included: about 2,900 THB / night (~$88) on Sun 24 and Mon 25 Jan 2027, about 3,600 THB (~$109) on Sat 23 Jan. Booking sites showed about 4,200 THB (Google Hotels, 16 Oct 2026).
items.whyStay: A free hotel shuttle goes to the airport at 14:30 (book it the day before), just right for the 18:20 flight. The terminal is about 10 minutes by car, and Nai Yang Beach is a short walk.
items.description: 4-star hotel on Nai Yang Soi 2, about 10 minutes on foot from Nai Yang Beach and 450 m from Sirinat National Park. Big pool, pool-access rooms, a bathtub in every room, buffet breakfast and a 24-hour front desk. Guests mention an evening market and massage shops close by.
items.nearby: Airport 1.7 km (about 10 min by car, hotel FAQ). Sirinat National Park 450 m. Nai Yang Fresh Market (16:00-19:00) about 100 m. Mai Khao plane-spotting point 12 km (about 20 min). Baba Beach Club (Natai) about 35-45 min. Patong about 1 hour.
tips: Check-out is 11:00 in the hotel FAQ but 12:00 in its booking terms. Ask at check-in, and ask for a late check-out or a place for your bags.
Free airport shuttle (a local 'Pho Thong' bus) at 8:30, 10:30 and 14:30, max 6 guests per trip: reserve at the front desk at least 1 day before.
Breakfast buffet 6:30-10:30 at Yai Yai restaurant.
The booking terms ask for a 3,000 THB damage deposit, returned when you leave, and the same credit card you booked with.

items.name: Phuket Marriott Resort and Spa, Nai Yang Beach
items.priceText: 1 guest, with taxes: about 8,600 THB / night (~$260) on Sun 24 and Mon 25 Jan 2027, but about 18,300 THB (~$555) on Sat 23 Jan (Google Hotels, 16 Oct 2026).
items.whyStay: A beach treat for the last night (Sun 24 or Mon 25 Jan), right on the sand at the quiet south end of Nai Yang. The terminal is about 10 minutes by car.
items.description: 5-star beach resort from 2016 with 180 rooms on three floors, two pools, a children's pool and a lazy river. Big Fish, its beach restaurant, gets most of its seafood from the small fishing village next door. The south end of Nai Yang Bay is quiet.
items.nearby: Airport 5 km (about 10 min by car). The Slate and Nai Yang beach restaurants about 1.5 km. Baba Beach Club (Natai) about 40-50 min. Café del Mar (Kamala) about 30-40 min.
tips: Check-in 15:00, check-out 12:00.
Saturday costs about twice as much as Sunday or Monday. Book Sun 24 or Mon 25 Jan.
Ask about a late check-out when you book: it depends on free rooms.

items.name: The Slate
items.priceText: 1 guest, with taxes: about 17,300-17,800 THB / night (~$525-540) for each night of 23-26 Jan 2027. The official rate could be cancelled for free until about one month before (official site via Google Hotels, 16 Oct 2026).
items.whyStay: The big treat: a famous Bill Bensley design resort, 5 minutes by car from the terminal, with two adults-only pools. Perfect for a slow last night and morning before the flight.
items.description: 5-star resort across the road from Nai Yang Beach, inspired by Phuket's old tin mines: steel, concrete and raw wood mixed with a tropical garden. Three pools, the Coqoon spa, a gym and several restaurants, including Black Ginger, a Thai restaurant on a lagoon that you reach by raft.
items.nearby: Airport 3 km (about 5 min by car). Nai Yang Beach across the road. Baba Beach Club (Natai) about 40-45 min. Café del Mar (Kamala) about 30-40 min.
tips: Check-in 14:00, check-out 12:00.
The Lagoon Pool is for families; the Pulley Pool and the Snakeskin Pool are adults-only (14+). Pools are open 08:00-18:00.
Black Ginger is open for dinner only, 17:30-23:00. Smart casual: no flip-flops or beachwear. Book a table.
